name: Wear X Apparel

about:
Wear X Apparel operates from Rapid City, South Dakota. The company was founded by Scott Lucero, who brings over 20 years of experience in the custom apparel industry. Lucero established the business as a one-stop shop for apparel design and manufacturing, drawing on a background that includes collaborations with major entertainment, music, and sports properties.

The shop offers a full suite of decoration and production services: cut-and-sew assembly, large-format sublimation, roll-to-roll printing, direct-to-film transfer, embroidery, and screen printing. It handles both commercial and low-volume runs, with equipment geared for high-volume output when needed. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

Clients span television (Sons of Anarchy, Gas Monkey Garage, The Walking Dead), music (Taylor Swift, The Rolling Stones, Billie Eilish, among others), rodeo (J.J. Harrison), motorsports (NHRA), energy drinks (Monster Energy), and hospitality (Aria Hotels and Casinos in Las Vegas). The company serves brands, entertainers, and corporate customers seeking custom apparel.

Wear X Apparel emphasizes its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, positioning itself as an experienced, reliable partner that can manage projects from design through delivery. The founder’s industry relationships and the breadth of in-house capabilities are cited as key differentiators.
